name: GuocoLand Limited
summary: GuocoLand Limited, an investment holding company, engages in the property investment and development businesses in Singapore, China, and Malaysia. It operates through GuocoLand Singapore, GuocoLand China, and GuocoLand Malaysia segments. The company develops, invests in, and manages a portfolio of commercial, mixed-used, residential, and integrated properties; and marketing and maintenance services, as well as operates hotels. It also offers planning and design, property management, and asset management services.
